stepSource.intro: Step 1 — Choose the backup source to restore from.

local.label: Local
local.description: Restore from a backup already present on this server.

usb.label: USB
usb.description: Restore from a plugged-in external drive (the backup must be located in BACKUP/<server name>/... on this drive).

gdrive.label: Google Drive
gdrive.description: If Google Drive is connected, the backup is first automatically downloaded to this server, then restored.

upload.label: Upload
upload.description: Send a backup file from your device (PC/phone) to this server, then restore it directly.

migration.label: Server migration
migration.description: Restore a full snapshot captured from an external drive (USB): sites, data, and system packages are reinstalled identically — to replace or rebuild a server.
migration.disabledReason: No migration snapshot on the USB drive

uploadForm.title: Upload a backup
uploadForm.validationError: File and source reference are required
